content.short: Levvy is a peer-to-peer Cardano NFT lending protocol built to give holders instant liquidity and lenders yield.
content.description: Levvy is a premier peer-to-peer (P2P) lending and borrowing protocol on Cardano, specifically designed for NFT and token holders to access instant liquidity. By using their digital assets as collateral, borrowers can receive ADA from lenders who compete by offering loan-to-value (LTV) ratios. The protocol features fixed interest rates and loan durations, ensuring transparency and efficiency for both parties. Built with the Aiken smart contract language, Levvy provides a highly secure and cost-effective marketplace that enhances the financial utility of digital assets across the ecosystem.
